candidate.rationale: Expresses the precise behavioural contract: the returned owned ExecMultiset has the same abstract multiset (same elements and multiplicities) as the borrowed receiver. This is the strongest straightforward spec available using the vstd DeepView vocabulary and matches the ToOwned/DeepView conventions.
risks: Function is marked external_body so the verifier will not check the implementation; the spec relies on the implementation actually performing deep clones.
Does not assert non-aliasing or independence of internal representation (aliasing/interior mutability is unexpressed).
Any bugs in DeepView/deep_clone for T or HashMap deep_view axioms could make this spec unsound in practice.
